content: {"summary":"The backlog on notifications.outbound grew to ~54,000 messages at 18:30 UTC on 29 June 2026 due to a slowdown in the email provider’s API, but messages were not deleted before workers could read them because the topic uses the default 7‑day retention and the oldest unread message was far from that limit.","likely_cause":"Email provider API slowdown reduced send throughput, causing consumer lag on notifications.outbound.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Messages were not deleted before workers read them because the topic uses the default 7‑day retention and the backlog was far from that limit.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#0","INC-0171#1"],"quote":"notifications.outbound has no retention override, so it keeps the broker default of 168 h"},{"text":"Lag grew because the email provider’s API answered slowly, reducing send throughput and increasing consumer lag on notifications.outbound.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#0","INC-0171#1"],"quote":"the email provider's API starts answering slowly; consumer lag on `notifications.outbound` begins to climb"}],"next_checks":["Verify the exact retention configuration of notifications.outbound on all brokers","Check Kafka disk usage and segment sizes for notifications.outbound during the incident window","Monitor email provider API latency and error rates to detect future slowdowns","Confirm that no messages were expired or deleted during the backlog period"]}
